summary: Iteration 104: Inventory Ingestion + Statistical Safety Stock - All backend (19/19) and frontend tests passed. Backend: Bulk inventory upload (upsert), inventory summary/list/sync-status, safety stock config CRUD with service level validation, safety stock calculation endpoint, buy formula uses statistical safety_method. Frontend: Inventory tab with summary cards, upload area, safety stock config panel with service level dropdown, review period slider, max weeks slider, Save/Cancel buttons on config change.

TEST_01_bulk_upload_new_records.notes: POST /api/buy-planning/inventory/bulk inserts new records, returns inserted/updated/failed counts

TEST_02_bulk_upload_upsert_existing.notes: Same store/sku/date updates existing record (upsert behavior)

TEST_03_bulk_upload_flexible_field_names.notes: Accepts store_id/sku_id as alternatives to store_code/sku

TEST_05_inventory_summary_returns_stats.notes: GET /api/buy-planning/inventory/summary returns total_records, total_soh, total_in_transit, unique_stores, unique_skus

TEST_06_sync_status_returns_last_sync.notes: GET /api/buy-planning/inventory/sync-status returns last_sync with synced_at, source, synced_by

TEST_07_list_inventory_all.notes: GET /api/buy-planning/inventory returns records array with total count

TEST_10_get_safety_config.notes: GET /api/buy-planning/safety-stock/config returns service_level, review_period_days, max_safety_weeks, z_score, is_default

TEST_11_update_safety_config_valid.notes: PUT /api/buy-planning/safety-stock/config updates config and returns z_score

TEST_15_calculate_safety_stock.notes: GET /api/buy-planning/safety-stock/calculate?sku=X&lead_time_days=14 returns safety_stock_units, mad, z_score, formula

TEST_16_calculate_different_lead_times.notes: Different lead times produce different safety stock values (sqrt relationship)

TEST_19_cleanup_test_inventory.notes: Test inventory records (TEST-STORE-*, TEST-SKU-*) remain in database

TEST_20_inventory_tab_visible.notes: Inventory tab with Package icon visible in Buy Planning tabs

TEST_21_inventory_summary_cards.notes: Summary cards show Total Records, Total SOH, In Transit, Stores, SKUs

TEST_22_inventory_upload_area.notes: data-testid=inventory-upload-area present with drag & drop UI

TEST_24_last_sync_status.notes: Last sync info displayed with date, user, source, records count

TEST_26_safety_service_level_dropdown.notes: data-testid=safety-service-level dropdown with service level options

TEST_29_save_cancel_buttons_on_change.notes: data-testid=save-safety-config-btn and Cancel button appear after changing config

TEST_30_save_config_persists.notes: Saving config shows success toast and updates z-score display

TEST_31_custom_config_indicator.notes: Shows 'Custom config active. Updated by {user}' after saving

critical_code_review_comments: Backend inventory endpoints:
- POST /api/buy-planning/inventory/bulk: Upserts records by tenant_id+store_code+sku+date, accepts flexible field names (store_id/sku_id)
- GET /api/buy-planning/inventory/summary: Aggregates total_records, total_soh, total_in_transit, unique_stores, unique_skus
- GET /api/buy-planning/inventory/sync-status: Returns last sync from inventory_sync_log collection
- GET /api/buy-planning/inventory: Lists records with optional store_code/sku filters
Backend safety stock endpoints:
- GET /api/buy-planning/safety-stock/config: Returns config with z_score and is_default flag
- PUT /api/buy-planning/safety-stock/config: Validates service_level in [0.80,0.85,0.90,0.95,0.98,0.99,0.999]
- POST /api/buy-planning/safety-stock/config/reset: Deletes tenant config, returns defaults
- GET /api/buy-planning/safety-stock/calculate: Calculates SS = z * MAD * sqrt(LT/RP)
Buy formula integration:
- POST /api/buy-planning/buy-formula/calculate now uses statistical safety stock
- Items have safety_method='statistical' field
- Safety calculation: z * mad * sqrt(lead_time / review_period), capped at max_safety_weeks * mad
Frontend Inventory tab:
- Summary cards: Total Records, Total SOH, In Transit, Stores, SKUs
- Upload area with drag & drop and file input (data-testid=inventory-upload-area, inventory-file-input)
- Safety Stock Configuration panel (data-testid=safety-stock-config)
- Service level dropdown (data-testid=safety-service-level)
- Review period slider (data-testid=safety-review-period)
- Max weeks slider (data-testid=safety-max-weeks)
- Save/Cancel buttons appear on config change (data-testid=save-safety-config-btn)
- Last sync status displayed with date, user, source
seed_data_creation: Test inventory records created: TEST-STORE-01, TEST-STORE-02, TEST-UPSERT-01, TEST-FLEX-01 with various SKUs. Safety config was tested with 0.98 service level then reset to defaults.
